## Field problem

Describe the field workflow and intended user using synthetic or generalized details.

## Change

Explain the implementation, data flow, side effects, and human review boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests/benchmark cases.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] I used no private client, tenant, employee, supplier, or job data.
- [ ] User-visible assumptions, exclusions, and approval requirements are explicit.
